mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at clear skies and 52 degrees near the Verona Public Library.

The City of Verona has announced that fall leaf collection begins on Monday, October 5, and asks residents to place loose leaves behind the curb. Also, the Plan Commission is meeting on that same day to review several development projects including work at Sub-Zero in Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the Verona Fall Fest at Hometown USA Festival Park or catch some live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard.

In our weekly report, we noted an incident from September 10 where officers responded to a burglary in the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way, resulting in an arrest after an officer provided medical assistance to the offender.
While Culver's is currently closed for a remodel, they are scheduled to open today at 10:00 AM. Be sure to stop by once they are back in action to enjoy the flavors of the day.
